o.text: From Proto-Turkic *köri-, *kör- (“to see, look”). Cognate to görmək (“to see”).

glosses: mold (woolly or furry growth of tiny fungi)

o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *kebü (“rot, dandruff”); cognate with Crimean Tatar küf, Karakhanid [script needed] (küviǯ), Kipchak [script needed] (küf) and Turkish küf.
From Proto-Turkic *köse- (“to stir with a poker; poker”).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *ẹ̄rte (“morning”), a derivation from Proto-Turkic *ẹ̄r (“early”). Cognate with Turkish erte.
From əməl + -li. The word əməl has connotations of intentional and consequential work, so the current senses evolved from something like "having meaningful consequences, working, functioning".
